claim(string).notice: Claims a new NairaTag with default empty resolver.

claim(string,address).notice: Claims a new NairaTag with an explicit target resolver.

exists(bytes32).notice: Checks if a tag node exists.

getRecord(bytes32).notice: Returns the full TagRecord for a node.

namehash(string).notice: Computes the 32-byte node hash for any tag input.

normalize(string).notice: Normalizes an input tag into its canonical form.         Strips leading '₦' (UTF-8 0xE2 0x82 0xA6),         rejects at-sign, converts uppercase ASCII to lowercase,         and validates character set [a-z0-9_] and length 3..32.

owner(bytes32).notice: Returns the owner of a tag node (ENSIP-1).

ownerOf(string).notice: Returns the owner of a raw or display tag.

primaryTagOf(address).notice: Returns the primary tag node owned by an address (1 tag per user).

resolve(string).notice: Resolves a raw or display tag to an EVM address.

resolver(bytes32).notice: Returns the resolver of a tag node (ENSIP-1).

resolverOf(string).notice: Returns the resolver set for a raw or display tag.

setResolver(bytes32,address).notice: Sets the resolver contract for a tag.

transfer(bytes32,address).notice: Transfers tag ownership to another address.
